messages:
Maya: Heads up — saw a small billing spike for customers with missing X-Api-Version header. They got routed to v1 fallback and incurred dedicated quota charges. Anyone seen this pattern?
Carlos: Yep, saw the same. Logs show header absent for mobile SDK versions <2.4. Fallback routing sends to /v1-compatible and counts against v1 reserved capacity.
Maya: Example we’re seeing: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{}' https://api.redwood.com/complete``` — no X-Api-Version. By default runtime picks legacy route.
Avery: Ouch. Should fallback be cost-neutral? Maybe we should route no-header to the cheapest compatible model (v2-lite) instead of v1? That would change behavior but reduce billing surprises.
Iris: Can we instead instrument telemetry first and create a `fallback_routed` metric tagged by tenant, route, and chosen_version? Right now it's just aggregated and not useful for billing investigations.
Carlos: Log snippet: ```[req_id=abc123] route=legacy-fallback tenant=acme consumed_tokens=12 model=v1-small``` — shows it definitely charged v1.
Avery: Proposal sketch: 1) Add telemetry tags (fallback_reason, original_header_present), 2) Add an opt-in per-tenant flag `fallback_charge_exempt` for emergency relief, 3) Surface a console preview listing affected tenants and recent fallback counts.
Maya: For rollout: instrument telemetry in prod (no behavioral change), canary the routing policy to 5% (route no-header -> v2-lite), monitor cost & latency, then flip and expose console toggles + docs.
Iris: Also recommend a soft-quota cap for fallback routing so a tenant doesn’t unexpectedly burn reserved capacity. Throttle fallbacks into the shared cheapest band.
Carlos: Note: v2-lite has different perf characteristics. We need perf benchmarks by seqlen buckets before making it default.
Avery: Agreed — I’ll run perf benches for seqlen [0-128,129-512,512+] across v1-small, v2-lite, v2-standard.
Maya: Action items: @Avery open perf ticket, @Iris add telemetry metric `fallback.routed` with tenant tag and route metadata, @Carlos collect sample logs and tenant list, I’ll draft the console UX for a new “Fallback policy” toggle. Target PR reviews by EOD Friday.
deploy-bot: rollout-job started: canary-telemetry-instrumentation -> env=staging
Carlos: I’ll pull the tenant list and flag any high-risk accounts, cc CS.
Maya: Thanks — if anyone wants to shadow the canary test, ping me. :thumbsup:
